austria.title: Flag of Austria
desc: - Three equal horizontal stripes of red-white-red, one of the oldest flag designs in the world
- Inspired by the legend of Duke Leopold V's bloodstained tunic during the Siege of Acre in 1191
trivia:
- The red-white-red design dates to 1191, making it one of Europe's oldest national symbols
- Legend says Duke Leopold V dropped his white belt during battle, leaving a white stripe on his bloodstained red shield
- Austria's flag is among the few with three stripes of equal width in these specific colours
